assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas, ratios, figures and spatial decisions are suitable only for conceptual discussion and package consistency checks; they must be recalculated from official polygons.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI concept submission, but no statutory, parcel-level, ownership or engineering conclusion may be drawn from it.

assumptions.statement: Alaya has no physical body. Night-walk observations, personas, dialogue, times and micro-events are synthetic narrative devices built from the task requirements, not fieldwork or interviews.
assumptions.impact: They may frame design questions but cannot serve as evidence of existing conditions, user demand or individual experience; real community participation is required before implementation.
